text:
Your prayers aren't failing. Your prayers aren't even yours.

It's early morning. You're reading from a book or listening to someone else speak, thinking the ritual matters. Nothing changes.

Your subconscious knows these aren't your words. It knows you don't believe them.

Prayer is your mind reaching your subconscious. That's it. Not tradition. Not the book. Not the place.

Someone else's words, no shift. Your words, everything shifts.
caption:
Discipline means doing it your way, not anyone else's.
Send this to a man who needs it today.
